description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableQueue class, a persistent FIFO queue implementation in Orleans that uses journaling to maintain durability across grain activations and restarts. The tests cover basic queue operations, persistence, complex value handling, clearing, edge cases, enumeration, performance with large data sets, and concurrent operation patterns.

classes.name: DurableQueueTests
classes.description: A test suite for the DurableQueue class, verifying its correctness, durability, and performance in various scenarios.

methods.name: DurableQueue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests enqueue, dequeue, peek, and count operations, verifying FIFO order and persistence.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that queue state is correctly persisted and recovered after recreating the queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Tests serialization and deserialization of custom complex objects enqueued and dequeued.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Clear_Test
methods.description: Tests the clear operation to ensure it removes all items and is journaled.

methods.name: DurableQueue_EmptyQueueOperations_Test
methods.description: Checks that peek and dequeue throw exceptions when performed on an empty queue.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the queue supports enumeration and maintains FIFO order.

methods.name: DurableQueue_LargeNumberOfOperations_Test
methods.description: Performs stress testing with thousands of enqueue/dequeue operations and recovery.

methods.name: DurableQueue_Concurrent_EnqueueDequeue_Test
methods.description: Simulates concurrent enqueue and dequeue operations, verifying correct order and recovery.
